d: Anusandhan parishad ke adhyaksh do. jedi patil ne jamshedpur daure ke dauran kaha ki varsh 2047 tak bharat men chhah sau miliyan tan stil utpadan ki kshamta viksit karne ka lakshy hai. unhonne svadeshi ri-yujebal roket taknik ko mahatvapurn batate hue kaha ki isse antriksh abhiyanon ki lagat men kami aaegi. vahin, jharkhand ekedmik kaunsil yani jaik bord ne maitrik aur intarmidiet ke vidyarthiyon ko rahat dete hue pariksha aavedan ki tithi 14 disanbar tak barha di hai. vidyarthi vilanb shulk ke sath 21 disanbar tak aavedan kar sakenge. idhar, sarak durghatnaon par ankush lagane aur yatayat…
